第016章 我上面有人！（求票求收！）
戒指内的空间犹如一个教室般那样大，空间内摆放着六个长五米，宽两米的木质柜台。柜台之上摆放着数十个白色的小玉瓶和一些奇花异草。除此之外还摆放着数十件灵器，有武器，披风，帽子，项链，护手，衣服，腰坠等各式的灵器。同时还有许多符咒，炼器材料，宝石等，一一都是珍贵无比。
“哈哈，值！太值了！”岳雨狂笑道。看着那散发着淡淡光韵的强大灵器，心中兴奋万分。
看着那些小玉瓶，岳雨意念一动，一个玉瓶便从空间内消失，一息之后，便出现在了他的手掌之上。冽的寒意，温度骤然下降，竟使得他冷的浑身颤抖。
岳雨急忙将瓶子盖住，屋内的温度这才有所好转。同时心中也是暗自震惊，自己的身体已经不是普通之躯，可以说四季的温度变化，对自己来说已经没有任何影响。但一枚小小的丹药就能散发出如此寒冷的气息，对炼药师不由多了几分好奇。
将瓶子放回戒指内，岳雨便没有再碰那些瓶子。虽然吞食丹药有可能提升自己的属性点，但他也不敢随意使用丹药。脑海之中的信息对人服食丹药也有所描述，丹药并不能随意服用。
丹药也分品级，分为九品。力武境的修士可以服食一品丹药，而至于二品丹药，很少有力武境的修士服食。因为二品丹药中所蕴含的能量，并不是力武境修士可以承受的。若是抵抗不住，轻则经脉爆废，成为废物，重则爆体而亡。
而戒指之中的丹药绝对不会是一品丹药，像富大有那样有财有势的强者，戒指之内又岂会放一些一品丹药？所以岳雨此刻也是不敢服食，若是爆体而亡那就太悲剧了，自己那引无数美女竞折腰的宏愿还未完成，怎能死掉。
看了一眼戒指之内的灵器，岳雨也并未打算穿戴，虽然穿上这些可以使自己的实力增强一些，但是自己现在实力还弱，穿上如此强大珍贵的灵器，那不是招人眼红吗。就好比你生活在一个全是强盗的城市，你突然有了几件价值连城的首饰，你敢戴上它出去逛悠？相信一出门便会引来无数强盗的抢夺。
反正这些丹药灵器现在都是自己的，岳雨也不急于一时，目前还是升级提升实力最为重要。
不久，便已是黄昏时刻。
暮色暗淡，残阳如血，厚厚的云雾盘踞在天空之上。镶着金边的落日此时正圆，光芒四射。点点光芒刺破云层，犹如一条条绛色霞彩，如梦似幻，美丽至极。
岳雨此刻正躺在床上，隔着窗户，欣赏着外面的美景，而楚莹也并未回来过。
“无聊啊，还是出去转转吧。”岳雨坐起身，伸了伸懒腰，便朝着屋外走去去。
此刻的开阳宗，在落日余晖的照耀下，金芒璀璨，散发着一股神圣的气息。
这时，开阳宗上空的云层之中，一名老者脚踏飞剑，遨游在天际之间。老者一袭紧身的白色长袍，身子消瘦，头发雪白，白须长飘。脸上沟壑纵横，双手之上也是一道道褶皱，显得很是苍老。但他的双眸却犹如夜空中的星辰，深邃而让人捉摸不透。
嘶！嘶！嘶！
老者口袋中的一本显得古朴的书籍竟然光芒闪烁，微微的颤抖了起来。老者惊咦了一声，揉了揉双眼，确信不是幻觉之后，脸色便变得无比的激动。“三百年了，终于有反应了，哈哈……”老者一阵兴奋，随即向下方看去，眼神仿若能穿透一切一般，下方的景物清晰可见。
“咦？！一个普通人，怎会是一个普通人？”老者看到地上的少年后，不由有些失望，眼神之中充满疑惑。
走出房屋的岳雨，丝毫没有注意到上面有个老者在打量着自己。只是看着远处的一座座璀璨的山峰与宫殿，赞叹道：“好美啊！”

就在岳雨沉浸在美丽的景色之中时，突然耳边传来了一道呵斥声：“你是什么人？竟胆敢擅闯我开阳宗？”
岳雨闻言转身一看，只见眼前站着一名年约十八岁的少年。少年身着一袭白色长袍，身材高大，四肢粗壮，表情冷然。骨子里更是透露着一股狂傲，怒视着岳雨，一脸的不善。
“你个傻B.”岳雨淡淡的回了一句，心中却是郁闷，这天灵界傻B还真是多。
“你说什么？！”少年微微一怔，一个普通人竟敢骂自己？随即怒目圆睁，心中的怒火瞬间燃起。
哎！岳雨无奈的叹息一声，便坐到了一旁的青石台上，用一副长辈指点晚辈的样子看着少年，道：“我一个普通人，你说我有能力闯进来吗？这可是开阳宗，五大宗门之一，高手云集啊。我一个无法修炼之人能闯入你们开阳宗？这说出去谁会相信？还是你认为以开阳宗的实力拦不住我一个普通人？”
岳雨的话让少年一阵语塞，随即冷哼一声，看着岳雨，一脸的不屑，道：“不管你是怎样进来的，这里都容不得你一个普通人在此，简直玷污了我开阳宗的名声！”
“哎，跟你说了半天，简直是对牛弹琴，你还是没明白。说你是傻B也是看得起你了。”岳雨无奈的一叹，用手揉了揉太阳穴，显得跟这种傻B说话很是头疼。
少年闻言不由大怒，心中的怒火已经是升腾到了极点，怒声道：“鬼话连篇的臭小子，看我今天怎么收拾你，说我是傻B？那我就把你给打成傻子！”
说完，周身便散发出一股磅礴浑厚的气息。嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，看着岳雨，就仿佛看着蝼蚁一般，眼中尽是轻蔑与不屑之色。
岳雨不为所动，脸色淡然，即使少年已经准备出手，还是静静的坐在石台上，丝毫不在意。
少年心中些疑惑，他为何会如此淡然？但随即也没多想。此时，他心中充斥着全都是怒火，只想着将其好好教训一番。
双脚一跨，拳头举起，便朝着岳雨挥去。
看着挥来的拳头，岳雨微微一笑，只是淡然的说了句：“我上面有人。”
随即，少年的动作戛然而止。深吸了一口气之后，压下心头的怒火，脸色变得阴晴不定。“他一个普通人能出现在开阳宗，肯定不是硬闯进来的，难道他上面真的有人？若是真的话，那我岂不是……”少年思索着，眉头微皱，心中不免有些担心，看着岳雨，淡淡的问道：“你是什么人？”
“哎，总算开窍了。”岳雨这时站起身，微微一笑道：“我是外门弟子。”

Chapter 016 There is someone above me! (Please vote for me!)
The space inside the ring is as big as a classroom, with six wooden counters five meters long and two meters wide. Dozens of small white jade bottles and some exotic flowers and plants were placed on the counter. In addition, there are dozens of spiritual weapons on display, including weapons, cloaks, hats, necklaces, gauntlets, clothes, waist pendants and other various spiritual weapons. There are also many charms, refining materials, gems, etc., all of which are extremely precious.
"Haha, it's worth it! It's so worth it!" Yue Yu laughed wildly. Looking at the powerful spiritual weapon that exuded a faint aura, I felt extremely excited.
Looking at those small jade bottles, Yue Yu thought, and a jade bottle disappeared from the space. After a breath, it appeared in his palm. The freezing cold and the sudden drop in temperature actually made him shiver with coldness.
Yue Yu hurriedly covered the bottle, and the temperature in the room improved. At the same time, I was secretly shocked. My body was no longer an ordinary body. It could be said that the temperature changes in the four seasons had no impact on me. But a small pill can emit such a cold breath, and I can't help but be more curious about the alchemist.
Putting the bottles back into the ring, Yue Yu didn't touch those bottles again. Although swallowing elixirs might increase his attribute points, he did not dare to use elixirs at will. The information in my mind also describes how people take elixirs, and elixirs cannot be taken at will.
Pills are also divided into grades, divided into nine grades. Monks in the powerful martial arts realm can take first-grade elixirs, but few monks in the powerful martial realm take second-grade elixirs. Because the energy contained in the second-grade elixir is not something that a Liwu realm monk can bear. If he cannot resist it, his meridians may explode and become waste, or his body may explode and die.
And the elixir in the ring will definitely not be a first-grade elixir. For a rich and powerful man like Fu Dayou, how can there be some first-grade elixir in the ring? Therefore, Yue Yu did not dare to take it at this moment. It would be too tragic if his body exploded and died. His ambition of attracting countless beauties has not yet been completed, so how could he die.
After taking a look at the spiritual weapons in the ring, Yue Yu had no intention of wearing them. Although wearing these could enhance his strength, he was still weak now. Wouldn't it make others jealous if he wore such a powerful and precious spiritual weapon? It's like you live in a city full of robbers, and you suddenly have a few priceless pieces of jewelry. Do you dare to wear them and go out for a walk? I believe that as soon as I go out, I will be robbed by countless robbers.
Anyway, these elixirs and spiritual weapons are all his own now, and Yue Yu is not in a hurry. At present, upgrading and improving his strength is the most important thing.
Soon, it was dusk.
The dusk was dim, the setting sun was like blood, and thick clouds and mist hung in the sky. The setting sun, trimmed with gold, was now perfectly round and radiant. Dots of light pierce the clouds, like strips of crimson clouds, dreamlike and extremely beautiful.
Yue Yu was lying on the bed at the moment, admiring the beautiful scenery outside through the window, but Chu Ying had never come back.
"It's boring, let's go out for a walk." Yue Yu sat up, stretched, and walked outside the house.
At this moment, Kaiyang Sect's golden light shines brightly under the afterglow of the setting sun, exuding a sacred aura.
At this time, among the clouds above Kaiyang Sect, an old man was flying in the sky with a flying sword. The old man was wearing a tight-fitting white robe, with a thin body, snow-white hair and a long white beard. There are ridges and grooves on his face, and there are also wrinkles on his hands, making him look very old. But his eyes were like stars in the night sky, deep and unpredictable.
hiss! hiss! hiss!
A simple-looking book in the old man's pocket actually shone with light and trembled slightly. The old man screamed in surprise, rubbed his eyes, and after making sure it was not an hallucination, his face became extremely excited. "Three hundred years, finallyThere is a reaction, haha..." The old man was excited for a while, and then looked down, his eyes seemed to be able to penetrate everything, and the scenery below was clearly visible.
"Eh? ! How can an ordinary person be an ordinary person? "When the old man saw the young man on the ground, he couldn't help but feel a little disappointed, his eyes full of doubts.
When Yue Yu walked out of the house, he didn't notice at all that there was an old man looking at him above. Just looking at the dazzling mountain peaks and palaces in the distance, I exclaimed: "How beautiful! "
Just when Yue Yu was immersed in the beautiful scenery, a scolding voice suddenly came from his ears: "Who are you? How dare you break into my Kaiyang Sect? "
When Yue Yu heard this, he turned around and saw a young man of about eighteen years old standing in front of him. The young man was wearing a white robe, tall, with thick limbs and a cold expression. There was even more arrogance in his bones, and he glared at Yue Yu with an unkind look on his face.
"You idiot." Yue Yu replied lightly, but she felt depressed in her heart. There were so many idiots in the spiritual world today.
"What did you say? ! "The young man was slightly startled. How dare an ordinary person scold him? Then his eyes widened with anger, and the anger in his heart instantly ignited.
Hey! Yue Yu sighed helplessly, then sat on the bluestone platform aside, looking at the young man as if an elder was pointing out a younger one, and said: "I am an ordinary person, do you think I have the ability to break in? This is Kaiyang Sect, one of the five major sects, and it has many masters. How can I, a person who cannot cultivate, break into your Kaiyang Sect? Who would believe this? Or do you think that Kaiyang Sect’s strength cannot stop me, an ordinary person? "
Yue Yu's words made the young man speechless for a while, and then he snorted coldly, looked at Yue Yu with a look of disdain, and said: "No matter how you came in, there is no room for you, an ordinary person, to be here. It has simply tarnished the reputation of our Kaiyang Sect! "
"Hey, I've been talking to you for a long time, it's like talking to a cow, but you still don't understand. Calling you stupid is just because I think highly of you. "Yue Yu sighed helplessly and rubbed his temples with his hands. He seemed to have a headache talking to such a stupid person.
The young man couldn't help but became furious when he heard this, and the anger in his heart had risen to the extreme. He said angrily: "You bastard who talks nonsense, look at how I deal with you today, do you think I'm a fool? Then I will beat you into a fool! "
After saying that, a majestic and rich aura emitted from his whole body. A sneer curled up at the corner of his mouth, and he looked at Yue Yu as if he were looking at an ant, with contempt and disdain in his eyes.
Yue Yu remained unmoved, with a calm expression. Even though the young man was ready to take action, he still sat quietly on the stone platform without caring at all.
The young man had some doubts in his heart, why was he so indifferent? But then he didn’t think much about it. At this time, his heart was filled with anger, and he just wanted to teach him a lesson.
He crossed his legs, raised his fist, and swung it towards Yue Yu.
Looking at the fist being waved, Yue Yu smiled slightly and said calmly: "There is someone above me. "
Immediately, the boy's movements stopped abruptly. After taking a deep breath, he suppressed the anger in his heart and his face became uncertain. "If he, an ordinary person, can appear in Kaiyang Sect, he must not have barged in. Is there really someone above him? If it is true, then wouldn't I..." The young man thought, frowning slightly, feeling a little worried. He looked at Yue Yu and asked lightly: "Who are you? "
"Hey, I finally figured it out. "Yue Yu stood up at this time, smiled slightly and said: "I am an outer disciple. "
